marta: Quick note — bringing up boreas-40k-int4 on staging. Observed token drift after ~31k prefills, looks like RoPE wraparound interacting with quant rounding. Short logs + repro below.

marta: repro steps:
```
# minimal repro
python -m tests.kv_long_repro --model boreas-40k-int4 --quant int4 --prefill tests/data/alternating_sys_shortlong.txt --max-tokens 32000 --inspect-kv --deterministic-keys false
```

lin: is this only with alternating system prompts?
marta: yes — the dataset alternates 2x short system lines with one long user story repeatedly. Float32 baseline clean. int4 shows single-index shift at high offsets.

ade: can you paste the tiny kv dump around the mismatch index? even 5 lines.
marta: pasted trimmed dump:
```
# kv dump around 31288
idx 31286 key=0x2ad3 fp=0x8a1f2b
idx 31287 key=0x2ad4 fp=0x8a1f2c
idx 31288 key=0x2ad5 fp=0x8a1f2d -> AFTER_PREFILL fp=0x8a1f2e
idx 31289 key=0x2ad6 fp=0x8a1f2f
```

ursula: hmm single-off increment. Could be a keyed-slot collision from tiled slot stride. What are your kv config args?
marta: running with default tiled stride: `--kv-tile 128 --kv-stride 16`. model cfg has `rotary_base: 10000, pos_scale: 1.02`.

lin: two quick experiments: 1) rerun with `--kv-stride 1 --kv-tile 65536` (force dense mapping), 2) rerun with `pos_scale: 1.0` (disable slight scaling). If either fixes it, we narrow root cause.

ade: also try `--deterministic-keys true` to rule out async insertion order.

infra-bot: Deployment: boreas-40k-int4 (int4) staged canary started (id: canary-20260211-9). Logs forwarded to /var/logs/onboard/boreas/canary-9.log

marta: kicked off three runs: dense-mapping, posscale-1.0, deterministic-keys. Will attach concise diffs.

lin: one more thought  if you see consistent bump by +1 index, check prefill->inflight merging code: we had an off-by-one in merge step for header tokens in prefetcher v2.

ade: if dense-mapping fixes it, attempt to repro with a shorter prefills set but repeated to reach same absolute index (to check absolute position vs content interleaving).

marta: results ETA ~15m. adding a tiny helper to print `idx, key_hash, fp_before, fp_after, nearby_tokens` per line to make diffs compact.

ursula: great. once you have diffs, post the minimal reproducer snippet and we'll triage. prefer single-file small repro for CI flaky tests. :mag:

marta: will do. thanks all.
